title: Prominence "Four Buoys and a Birdie" 24 W Crabbing Hole Lane
h1: Prominence "Four Buoys and a Birdie" 24 W Crabbing Hole Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Professionally decorated- Steps away from the Gulf- Nearby neighborhood pool- 4 adult bikes- 6- Seater golf cart- Walking distance to The Big Chill- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Four Buoys and a Birdie is located within the Hub 30A district of Watersound on Rosemary Beach. Guests will love this desirable family-friendly district with restaurants, shops, and more. This lovely 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath coastal home with bunk area and trundle sleeps 14.As you enter the first floor of this 2-story home, admire the hardwood floors, beautiful trim, and exposed beams that make this house a home. The bright and airy great room seamlessly blends the living, dining, and kitchen areas—perfect for entertaining. Listen to music from the chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and farmhouse sink as you make dinner for everyone to enjoy at the 8-seat dining room table or 5-stool breakfast bar. Host friends and family in the living room on the 2 linen-white couches and upholstered armchairs before dinner. Down the hallway, you will find a dreamy king suite with access to the outdoor patio.Ascending the staircase, you will come upon 4 spacious guest bedrooms perfectly spaced out for privacy. The primary suite includes a king bed and private bath with access to stunning views on the balcony. The additional bedrooms have 2 queen beds and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunks and 1 twin trundle bed.Outside the house in the back, you can find a screened-in porch for those breezy summer evenings, a large patio with alfresco dining table and seating for 8, and a natural gas grill great for throwing some steaks on. Keep the night going with friends and family by relaxing around the fire pit in the 6 Adirondack chairs, or unwind and breathe fresh air on the cushioned patio lounge chairs and outdoor sofas. Don’t forget about the outdoor shower after the beach.Vacations are designed to make life feel more like a retreat—so book Four Buoys and a Birdie today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Daybed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Area: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds and Twin Trundle Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only*The community north pool is heated between October/November and March/April.*

Guests will love this desirable family-friendly district with restaurants, shops, and more. This lovely 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath coastal home with bunk area and trundle sleeps 14. As you enter the first floor of this 2-story home, admire the hardwood floors, beautiful trim, and exposed beams that make this house a home. Listen to music from the chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and farmhouse sink as you make dinner for everyone to enjoy at the 8-seat dining room table or 5-stool breakfast bar. Keep the night going with friends and family by relaxing around the fire pit in the 6 Adirondack chairs, or unwind and breathe fresh air on the cushioned patio lounge chairs and outdoor sofas. Don’t forget about the outdoor shower after the beach. Vacations are designed to make life feel more like a retreat—so book Four Buoys and a Birdie today!
